title: Hussain ka matam
body:
Hussain ka matam
Weqaare deen e khuda hai, hussain ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
Payambaro ne kiya hai, hussain ka matam
Weqaare deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Zamana laakh mukhalif ho, ruk nahi sakta..(2)
ke fatema ki dua hai, hussain ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Yazeed isse badi aur kya hai teri shikast..(2)
ke tere ghar me bapa hai, hussain ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Khuda, rasool, farishte, imam sab hai wahan..(2)
jahan kahin bhi bapa hai, hussain ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Khabar nahi hai ye fatwe farosh mufti ko..(2)
ali ke ghar se chala hai, hussain ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kisi bhi ghayr ke darr par wo kaise phaylega..(2)
jo haath karta raha hai, hussain ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aye binte fatema zehra teri ataa ke tufayl..(2)
hame naseeb hua hai, hussain ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Baroz e hashr khabar lenge uski payghambar..(2)
jise khabar nahi kya hai, hussain ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Wilaye aale nabi ki tarha se mir hasan..(2)
mere lahu me mila hai, hussain ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
Weqaare deen e khuda hai, hussain ka matam..(2)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
